static_traits.name: Carrie
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, has a cat; Mother was a Nurse
static_traits.social_status: Recently broke up with partner, feeling Loneliness and isolation, tending to Be alone
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; have not received psychotherapy before; no similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, negative tone, inner dialogue of self-criticism appears, fairly good cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: Because I sewed a new shirt but think the fabric pattern is not nice, causing my Low mood.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize the negative thoughts about this shirt have affected my mood and self-image, so I am seeking counseling support.
growth_experiences: After recently breaking up with my partner, I feel Loneliness and isolation; tending to Be alone and relying mainly on my pet cat for comfort. Meanwhile Work stress increased, causing overall Low mood and decreased motivation, losing interest in previously enjoyed activities (like sewing).

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent.
My value depends on others' evaluations.

special_situations.event: Seeing or thinking about the newly sewn shirt when Being alone at home
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work has flaws, it means I have no ability, I cannot do anything well.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids displaying works; avoids directly facing feelings of failure through overtime and distraction; stays at home with the cat to reduce outside evaluation.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even make a decent shirt, I cannot do anything well.

special_situations.event: Thinking of wearing this shirt in public or letting others see it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' liking and disliking determines the value of my work and me; if others do not like it, it means I am terrible.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding showing the shirt to anyone, Reduced socializing contact to avoid being judged.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Unless others say it is good, it is ugly; they will think I made it badly.

special_situations.event: Focusing on the pattern's 'not-nice' appearance when examining the finished shirt
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only flawless works count as good; one flaw can Undo all effort and merits.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly nitpicking, ignoring the effort and skill in the making process, negating the work's positive side.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shirt is terrible, with nothing worthwhile.

special_situations.event: Seeing the shirt during Low mood after breakup and Work stress compounded
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: When I feel bad, things themselves must also be bad.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Displacing attention through overtime, but still Projecting low mood onto the shirt.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everything is getting worse; this shirt is also a symbol of failure.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and seen (hoping one's works and abilities are affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, humiliated and Being rejected (worrying others' evaluations will confirm I am 'not good enough')
defense_goal: Keeps distance and avoids external evaluation to lower the risk of being hurt and shamed

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough creator prone to criticism / a loser
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges / people who may mock and negate me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to show the shirt to others or wear it in public
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing suggestions as possible external humiliation and negation, believing others will mock or confirm I 'cannot do it well' (transference: Projecting past Fear of being judged onto current others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses 'they will think it is ugly' in a worried and hesitant tone, avoiding concrete commitments and details, tending to postpone or circumvent the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Being alone at home, Negative self-evaluation activated when directly facing the shirt
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turns anger and loss toward the outside world (breakup, work pressure) onto the self, viewing the work as evidence of own failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (like 'I cannot even make a decent shirt'), in a low tone, reducing eye contact, shortening answers and avoiding positive information.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Facing possible future evaluations and uncertainty (e.g. considering letting a trusted person see the shirt)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Emotionally preparing for negative outcomes in advance, to reduce Anxiety from the Unknown
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expresses in a cautiously reserved tone 'I worry they will confirm my thoughts, but let me try', emphasizing step by step, setting boundaries, and minimal exposure.

manifestations: After the recent breakup Feels isolated; unwilling to be with others, relying mainly on the cat for comfort; tending to Be alone, avoiding socializing and showing works
outcomes: Decreased motivation (losing interest in sewing and other activities)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the behavioral impulse they would originally act outwardly, turning the energy onto themselves or bearing it themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not showing the shirt to anyone, avoiding social evaluation
Displacing attention through overtime rather than seeking external feedback
Turning loss and anger into self-criticism

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, including excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, being overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Inner critical dialogue ('you cannot even make a decent shirt')
Fearing others will confirm negative evaluations and not daring to show
Generalizing one work's insufficiency into overall inadequacy

positive_force: Having sewing skills and the ability to complete works
Willing to try reality testing (considering showing it to trusted people)
Can do basic self-soothing through the companionship of a pet cat
Has a job and some daily structure
negative_force: Social withdrawal and isolation, over-caring about others' evaluations
Emotional reasoning and mental filtering, ignoring positive evidence
Work stress increased, overall Low mood affecting function

target_behavior.behavior: When seeing or thinking of shirts, strong self-criticism and avoidance of showing appear
antecedent: Seeing the shirt when Being alone at home
Thinking about dressing up or being seen by others in public
When Low mood results from breakup and Work stress compounding
target_behavior.core_reason: Recent breakup and Work stress causing Low mood, Projecting negative emotions onto the work; value over-relying on others' evaluations and perfection as the standard, causing negation of positive information and overgeneralization.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame, briefly lowering Anxiety.
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent Low mood and Self-image damaged; Decreased motivation and Reduced interest in sewing; avoiding socializing and feedback, maintaining the negative cognitive cycle.

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal and isolation (reducing contact with others, avoiding showing works)
antecedent: Feeling Loneliness and negated after breaking up with partner
When Anticipating others will give negative evaluations
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being negated and humiliated, reducing outside contact and evaluation opportunities for Self-protection.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding emotional pain and outside judgment, maintaining a superficial sense of safety.
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening Loneliness, Negative emotions persisting; Decline in work performance and Reduced life satisfaction.
